task: controlled sequence-order forward diagnosis, not toxicity evaluation of artificial sequences
cohort: all450 baseline4 errors plus all harms of either previous fusion, plus5 persistent-correct samples per original label*Cys<4/ge4*length<=25/gt25*originalfold stratum selected by fixed hash, plus all controls in prior matched_controls.json. Retain whole error classes; outcome-selected exploratory cohort not general population estimate.
perturbations: Cys_relocation:random Cys position set, nonCys relative order fixed
randomization: SHA256(sample_id|mode|rep|saprot_order_v1) deterministic seed; up to20 draws to avoid unchanged sequences, otherwise ineligible; all preserve composition and length
encoders: local frozen original ProtT5 1024 residue outputs pooled mean/max/populationstd, plusPhysChem9; local frozen SaProt35M AA+# mean480, same as original unstructured comparator. Sequential GPU extraction; no old3Di token assignment to mutated AA
classifiers: originalfold checkpoints only; baseline4 seeds26/27/28/29; teacher masked2 seeds26/27; fusion equal probabilities of baseline26/27+teacher26/27; no fit, no calibration, no weight selection
anchor_gate: before mutated-sequence encoding: re-encode at least16 label-free hash-selected original cohort sequences including lengths; cached vs fresh feature cosine each>=0.995 for both representations; full-cohort median absolute ensemble-probability difference<=0.02 and original decision agreement>=0.98 for base4 and teacher2. If failure stop mutated encoding and diagnose representation contract. Fresh originals used as paired reference; cached outcome role is metadata only.
clamp: For Cys_relocation and global_all_shuffle additionally score baseline with mutantProtT5 but originalPhysChem9; first8 values must composition-invariant to1e-6, first8clamped always invariant, minCys_spacing separately logged. NonCys-only perturbations must leave allPhysChem9 invariant to1e-6. Distinguish direct descriptor path from embedding response.
outputs: per sample/mode/rep raw logits and probabilities, feature changes, changed residue fraction, composition/Cys invariants, eligible/unchanged and exact-match-to-neural-training flags. Exclude no-change/exact-otherfold-training from clean summaries; keep records.
metrics: mean replicate absolute probability/logit changes and original decision flip rate per original sample; group-bootstrap2000 of paired SaProt2-vsbaseline2 change; probability and scale-normalized logit differences both reported (95% descriptive and conservative99.6875% for16 mode*role*metric comparisons across maskedcorrected/harmed), original fivefold directions; report base4 and fusion also; not classify perturbations as toxic/non-toxic groundtruth. Multiplicity tightened before sensitivity summaries and inspection; encoding may already have finished.
original_member_diagnostic: report baseline2 versus baseline4 original corrected-role overlap and cases already correct in baseline2; primary original-role assignment is unchanged, but don't attribute seed replacement to teacher knowledge
scale_control: also divide absolute change of ensemble logodds by the model's cached-original logodds SD within its originalfold (all training OOF, no label scaling); compare with probability changes to expose confidence/saturation effects. Added before seeing perturbation outcomes.
matched: reuse existing same-label/fold/sequence-background pairs, no relaxed rematching. Compare response of cases/controls, report coverage, changed fractions, n and original label/Cys strata; head reaction differences can be scaling/saturation, not proof of better representation or causal biology
family: cached names/curated families as metadata; sparse actual family matches, no family-mechanism conclusion from 1-2 examples
guardrails: No assign true toxicity labels to mutants, no classification-performance claims or mechanism causation, no generating new predicted3D or MD, no external/test1/test2 use, no adapting checkpoints. If local/global perturbations differ in amount, report that confound. No parameter/seed search to obtain a desired effect.
